Subject: Renewal + expansion: onboarding & procurement orientation (Helix Health)

Marta / procurement team —

Thanks again for the productive call on Tuesday. Per our notes Helix is planning a renewal for the existing committed capacity (Q3 start) and a staged capacity increase for a new clinical analytics pilot (+40% token budget). To keep the cutover smooth we recommend a short procurement/onboarding orientation so your procurement & IT teams understand the portal flow and PO split options.

Attached is our procurement_onboarding_checklist.xlsx which covers the documents Helix will need to upload to your portal, suggested PO lanes (license vs usage), and common timelines for SOC2 evidence. Can you confirm: 1) the portal contact for vendor enrollment, 2) whether you need a single consolidated PO or split POs (license / usage), and 3) who the billing contact is?

Proposed times for a 30-min orientation next week: Tue 10am PT, Wed 2pm PT, Thu 11am PT — I can send calendar invites once you pick one.

Thanks — looking to keep the renewal on track so the pilot can start Aug 1.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-1482

Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: onboarding & procurement orientation (Helix Health)

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the checklist — helpful. A few quick answers:
- Portal contact: myself (procurement@helixhealth.com) and our vendor-ops inbox (procurement@helixhealth.com).
- PO preference: We prefer a primary PO for contract license line and a secondary PO (or invoice schedule) for usage/overages.
- Billing contact: finance_ap@helixhealth.com (I will loop them if needed).

We also require a completed vendor enrollment form and our standard vendor addendum (attached). Can you send the SOW and the vendor W9? Once those are uploaded our portal usually issues a vendor ID within 2 business days.

Orientation: Wed 2pm PT works for us.

Thanks,
Marta Rios
Procurement Manager, Helix Health
Marta.Rios@helixhealth.com

Finance confirmed we can accept a split PO approach. We'll treat the license PO as a standard contract line (net30) and set up a secondary usage PO that can be billed on a monthly statement. I've attached PO_template_Helix.xlsx. If Helix can provide the vendor-signed W9 and the SOW by EOD Monday we can have vendor enrollment queued with Finance to issue a vendor ID.

Ben — can you flag any contractual language we should pre-clear (data residency / API call SLAs) so Legal has a heads-up?

—Lauren
